labels.samplesIntroDefault: Each style below is a ready-made sample — tap to play it, and every worksheet is free to print.
labels.crossLangIntro: The same maker also builds picture-vocabulary worksheets for learning a new language.

modes.find-addend: Show one part and the total; children work out the missing addend.
modes.image-image: Add two groups of pictures and count them all to find the sum.
modes.image-number: Count a group of pictures, then add it to a number for the total.
modes.mixed: A mix of picture sums and number sums together on one page.

modes.cross-out: Children cross out pictures to take them away and count what is left.
modes.find-subtrahend: Show the start and the answer; children find the number taken away.
modes.image-number: Count a group of pictures, then subtract a number from it.
modes.mixed: A mix of picture and number take-away problems on one sheet.

modes.default: Solve each sum, then use the number key to crack a hidden picture code.
modes.secret-word: Solve the sums and the answers spell out a fun secret word.

modes.check-cross: Children mark which group has more and which has fewer.
modes.image-image: Compare two groups of pictures and decide which is more or less.
modes.image-number: Compare a group of pictures against a number — more, less or equal?

modes.addition: Number-grid puzzles where every clue is an addition fact.
modes.subtraction: Number-grid puzzles built entirely from take-away facts.
modes.mixed: Puzzle grids that mix addition and subtraction clues.

modes.two-symbols-add-sub: Two-number sums with a plus or minus, neatly laid out to solve.
modes.three-symbols-add-sub: Three-number problems combining plus and minus in one line.
modes.four-symbols-add-sub: Longer four-number strings of plus and minus to work through.

modes.letter-hint: Each carriage shows a letter hint to help build the alphabet train.
modes.default: Build the alphabet train by placing the letters in the right order.

modes.fillin: Children write the position word (in, on, under…) that fits each picture.
modes.multiplechoice: Pick the correct position word for each picture from the choices.

modes.easy: Shorter words with picture clues for early readers to guess.
modes.normal: Longer words and trickier clues for confident readers.

modes.easy: Unscramble short, familiar words with a picture clue to help.
modes.normal: Unscramble longer words for a bigger spelling challenge.

modes.default: Hide a list of words in the grid for children to find and circle.
modes.image-only: A picture word search — children find the words for the pictures shown.

cryptogram.samplesIntro: Make decode-the-message puzzles where symbols stand in for letters.

modes.findBig: Children spot and tap the biggest (or smallest) picture in each set.
modes.orderAsc: Put the pictures in order from smallest to biggest.

modes.aab: Repeating A-A-B picture patterns for children to continue.
modes.aabb: A-A-B-B patterns that build a steady two-by-two rhythm.
modes.abb: A-B-B patterns to read, predict and extend.
modes.abc: Three-part A-B-C patterns with a longer repeating unit.
modes.default: Mixed repeating patterns where children work out what comes next.

pattern-worksheet.samplesIntro: Create mixed pattern worksheets for children to read and complete.

chart-count.samplesIntro: Build count-and-graph worksheets where children tally pictures into a chart.

modes.letter: Draw a line from each picture to the letter it starts with.
modes.name: Match each picture to its written word.

grid-match.samplesIntro: Build grid-matching worksheets that pair pictures across a grid.

modes.find-shadow: Match each picture to its matching shadow shape.
modes.make-whole: Join the two halves that make each picture whole again.

bingo.samplesIntro: Make picture and word bingo cards your whole class can play together.

picture-sort.samplesIntro: Make sorting worksheets where children group pictures into the right baskets.

modes.one-missing: One piece is missing from the picture — children pick the part that completes it.
modes.two-missing: Two pieces are missing, so children choose both parts to finish the picture.

modes.same-theme: Every picture shares a theme except one — find the odd one out.
modes.cross-theme: Pictures come from different themes; children spot the one that does not fit.

modes.easy: Gentle picture sudoku grids for a first try at the puzzle.
modes.medium: A step up, with slightly fuller grids to reason through.
modes.hard: Trickier grids that need more careful logic to complete.

modes.choose-path: Children choose the correct route through a picture maze.
modes.classic-maze: A classic maze to trace from start to finish without crossing walls.
modes.pathway: Follow the picture pathway from one end to the other.

modes.hidden-object: Children hunt for hidden objects in a busy scene and count them.
modes.letter-spotting: Search the picture for a target letter and count every one found.

modes.find-odd: Spot the one picture in the row that does not belong with the others.
modes.i-spy: An I-Spy scene where children find and count the named objects.

crossword.samplesIntro: Create picture crosswords where children spell each word into the grid.

modes.cardinal-arrows: Follow up, down, left and right arrows across the grid to the treasure.
modes.compass: Use compass directions to navigate the map and find the treasure.
